title: Tear Review off into its own window

options.label: Yes, with Bring Back like projects
options.act: WindowGroup('Review', for: ReviewScope); drag-out + ⌥⌘R; restored at launch; Bring Back
options.then: Let Review tear off into its own window, restored at launch, with Bring Back.

options.label: No: Review stays inside project windows

why: Drag the Review pane out of a project window, or press ⌥⌘R, and it becomes its own window (WindowGroup("Review", for: ReviewScope), for one project or for all). It's restored at launch like project windows are. Switchboard already does this for whole projects ("Show Window" and "Bring Back"), and Safari, Xcode and Finder do it with tabs.
This suits a second screen: Review on one display, the running app on the other, with no window switching.
